Chapters
A National awardee, Ashish Vidyarthi has established himself as a versatile actor in the Hindi film industry as well as Telugu, Tamil, Malayalam, Kannada, Odia, Marathi, and Bengali.
Born in 1965 in Delhi, Ashish ji has been a student of National School of Drama.
His first film was Sardar based on the life of Sardar Vallabh Bhai Patel.
